title: Ali ali ali ali bol
body:
Ali ali ali ali bol
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Misam ki tarah tune..(2) gar hona hai anmol
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khud bigda hua tera
har kaam banaegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer tere piche piche chali aaegi
dar dar na laga fere..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
bus todke kashkol
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Baghdad ki galiyo me
ye kaisi tijaarat hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pucha jo zubaida ne kya khuld ki qeemat hai
Rukh sue najaf karke..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehne lage bahlol
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ye raaz koi samajta nai nabi ke siwa
Mujhe kisise mohabbat nai ali ke siwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Fishare qabr se dozakh se aur mushkil se
Koi bacha nai sakta ali ali ke siwa
<<DIVIDER>>
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
4. Milne ke liye tujhse aaye hai tere maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ashiq e haider hai kya khauf hai turbat ka
Bole ye malak mujhse..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ankhe toh zara khol
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Maula ki mavaddat se
maulai banata hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aulad ko har momin bachpan se sikhata hai
Jab rab ne zabaa di hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aur na kuch bol
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Yahi wazifa hai mera yahi taraana hai
Ali wali se ta'aluk bada purana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zamaane maanle ye mashwara takallum ka
Munafiqo se aqeeda agar chupana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ALI ALI ALI ALI bol..(4)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
